title: types.VulnImpactedResources
description: VulnImpactedResources holds details about the resources impacted by vulnerability

_id.description: ID is the CVE ID (index for the impacted resources).

functions.description: Functions is a map between function id to its details.

functionsCount.description: FunctionsCount is the total impacted functions count.

hosts.description: Hosts is the list of impacted hosts.

hostsCount.description: HostsCount is the total impacted hosts count.

images.description: Images is the list of impacted hosts.

imagesCount.description: ImagesCount is the total impacted images count.

registryImages.description: RegistryImages is a list of impacted registry images.

registryImagesCount.description: RegistryImagesCount is the total impacted registry images count.

types.ImpactedContainer.description: ImpactedContainer contains details of a running container with an impacted image

types.ImpactedPackage.description: ImpactedPackage holds the vulnerability details for a package

cvss.description: CVSS is the vulnerability cvss score for this package.

package.description: Package is the impacted package name and version.

severity.description: Severity is the vulnerability severity for this package.

types.ImpactedResourceDetails.description: ImpactedResourceDetails holds the vulnerability details for a specific impacted resource

containers.description: Containers are the running containers of this image found in the environment.

functionDetails.description: FunctionDetails is a formatted string holding function details.

packages.description: Packages holds vulnerability details per impacted package found in this resource.

resourceID.description: ResourceID is a resource identifier (e.g. image ID, hostname).

types.RiskScoreFactors.description: RiskScoreFactors holds factors used to calculate risk score

envVarSecrets.description: EnvVarSecrets indicates whether a container has access to secrets via environment variables.

hostAccess.description: HostAccess indicates whether a container has access to the host network or namespace.

internet.description: Internet indicates whether a container has internet access.

network.description: Network indicates whether a container is listening to ports.

noSecurityProfile.description: NoSecurityProfile indicates whether a container has security profile issue.

privilegedContainer.description: PrivilegedContainer indicates whether a container runs using the --privileged flag.

rootMount.description: RootMount indicates whether a container has access to the host file system using a root mount.

rootPrivilege.description: RootPrivilege indicates whether a container runs as root.

runtimeSocket.description: RuntimeSocket indicates whether a container has the runtime socket mounted.
